entities.summary: Every .dev file is validated, and each changed game is tested and built without deploying.
checks: For each game changed outside its .dev folders, or every game when .github/ changed outside .github/.dev: game.yml (install, tests, build)
entities.blocks: nothing on its own: main requires only the Database migration check
notChecked: The scripts in .github/scripts/ have no tests of their own.

entities.title: Database migration check
entities.summary: The pull request check main requires: a database change waits for its acknowledgement.
entities.trigger: A pull request opened, edited, pushed to or reopened (migrations.yml).
checks: migration-gate.sh pr: any games/*/worker/schema.sql or worker/migrations/ change, outside .dev, needs an acknowledgement line in the description
notChecked: Whether the migration was in fact applied to production: the gate reads the acknowledgement, not the database.

entities.title: Deploying, by hand
entities.summary: Nothing deploys from GitHub: the owner runs npm run deploy in a game's folder, which runs its tests, its build, then wrangler deploy.
entities.trigger: The owner, on their own machine.
secrets: The owner's wrangler login, or CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, for icelander.net's Cloudflare account
notChecked: The migration gate does not run on its own any more: whoever deploys applies a game's migrations first, and can run migration-gate.sh deploy by hand to list them (docs/database-migrations.md).
